verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts: a directory holding a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and Markdown, plus optional scripts, references, and assets. They follow the published Agent Skills open standard for cross-platform portability, and a community user reports using a skill directory with Codex, so locally authored skills are already in open, portable formats. However, nothing shows an export or download path for skills uploaded to a workspace via the Skills API or Claude.ai, so 'export all of my data and leave' is only half evidenced. Missing for 10: documented export/download of API- or Claude.ai-hosted skills, an explicit data-export or offboarding feature, and independent hands-on reports of migrating skills to another platform.
